title: Get the owner's decisions: pad note layout, MIDI file or clip, audio by reference, markup kinds
description:
## Intent

Get the owner's decisions on the questions the format leaves open, before specs are written, and record them on the initiative (apricitus-5562e0).

## Decisions to get

1. Pad note layout: sliced kits from C1 (note 36) upward, named drum pads on the usual drum notes. Kits larger than 92 pads (notes 36-127): refuse, or start lower?
2. The step pattern proof (M2): a Standard MIDI File (`.mid`) next to the preset, or a MIDI clip file (`.alc`)?
3. Clip files and presets reference the library's audio in place (no copies), or copy the audio next to them (`--copy-audio`) so the folder can be moved to another machine?
4. Which markup kinds go in the clip folder: sections, loops, shots only (as the initiative says), or holds and phrases too?
5. The naming scheme draft in `design/daw-presets.md`: letter, length, key; what to do when a clip has no section or no key.
6. Saved kits (planned in design/vocabulary.md) are not built yet: export kits from scores only for now?

## Verification

One comment on the initiative listing each decision; the design note updated to match (`git diff design/daw-presets.md`).

## Release

No commit of its own (board only). Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the design note task.
